messages:
olivia_support: escalated from support — customer (AcmePay) reports repeated mid-stream disconnects when switching from Wi‑Fi→cell on iOS. They see partial SSE output (last chunk truncated) and client logs `HTTP 499` from our proxy. Happening in prod, ~30% of requests during mobile handoff. Repro steps included.
raj_sre: looking — do we have the client SDK version and sample request/headers? 499 implies client closed socket; could be app timeout or iOS dropping NSURLSession stream on interface change.
emily_mobile_eng: client says using our iOS SDK 1.4.2 (SSE path), `connectTimeout=30s` `readTimeout=60s`. Also using Alamofire wrapper. App moves to background briefly during handoff.
olivia_support: attaching repro steps from customer:
```
1) Open chat, start stream (long response ~40s)
2) toggle Wi‑Fi off (phone switches to LTE)
3) observe partial tokens, then stream ends; client logs: "task canceled" and server logs show 499 around same time
```
raj_sre: can we see proxy/nginx vs app 499? If nginx sees `499` it's client-side close. Check proxy access log for `upstream_response_time` and `request_time`.
emily_mobile_eng: quick hypothesis — iOS may cancel the data task during network change. Workarounds: enable `NSURLSession` allowsExpensiveNetworkAccess? Also set `waitsForConnectivity = true` and use `HTTP/2` keepalive. But more practical: reduce client aggressive socket timeout and implement reconnect-with-resume (send last-seen token offset) so partial outputs don't get lost.
olivia_support: customer asked for immediate workaround — they can't roll SDK now. Any server-side mitigations?
raj_sre: server-side: increase SSE flush frequency (smaller chunks) so client can process partials quicker; add a short retry window — mark session as resumable for 10s after disconnect; if client reconnects with `X-Resume-Id` we replay remaining tokens. Also ensure we don't close upstream immediately on early client close for ~5s to allow cellular bounce-back. Need product/eng approval for durable resume.
emily_mobile_eng: quick patch we can do in SDK: retry on iOS `NSURLErrorNetworkConnectionLost` and `NSURLErrorCannotConnectToHost` with exponential backoff. For now suggest customer: set app network timeout to 120s and enable background fetch to keep socket alive during short handoffs.
olivia_support: customer provided sample request headers and token: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>` `Connection: keep-alive` `Accept: text/event-stream`. Also using Cloudflare in front.
raj_sre: CF can prematurely terminate long connections on mobile handoffs; ask CF support for `stream: true` or adjust `timeout` for that zone. Also check that our Load Balancer TCP idle timeout > client timeout.
emily_mobile_eng: repro plan — I can simulate Wi‑Fi→cell on simulator with network link conditioner. If we confirm, I'll open a PR for SDK retry and a feature request for server-side resumable sessions.
olivia_support: next steps: 
- ask customer to try increasing app read timeout to 120s and retry
- get proxy/nginx access logs (raj)
- emily to attempt local repro this afternoon
- I'll send customer a KB with temporary config steps and request logs

:thumbsup:
